requirement: The system shall refuse to process a payroll run when any employee in the pay group has an incomplete bank account record.
The system shall compute an employee's gross pay for a period as the sum of their base salary, any overtime at the applicable rate and any approved bonus.
The payroll administrator enters a new employee's contract; the system validates salary is within the band, records the contract and schedules it to start on the effective date.
The employee submits a holiday request; the system checks remaining entitlement, verifies no clashes with team cover requirements and records the request as pending approval.
As an employee, I want to download my payslip for a chosen month so that I can keep it for my records.
As a payroll officer, I want to run the monthly payroll so that every active employee is paid and the results are recorded for reporting.
An employee's recorded salary must not be visible to colleagues who are not their line manager or a member of the HR team.
Any change to an employee's salary or bank details must be recorded in an audit trail with the old value, the new value, the actor and the timestamp.
The payslip table shall ensure that gross pay is greater than or equal to net pay, and that every payslip refers to a valid employee.

-- payslip table for the payroll system
CREATE TABLE payslip (
    payslip_id     BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id    BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    pay_month      DATE          NOT NULL,
    gross_pay      NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    total_deductions NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    net_pay        NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    currency       CHAR(3)       NOT NULL,
    issued_at      TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT payslip_employee_fk FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employee(employee_id),
    CONSTRAINT payslip_gross_nonneg CHECK (gross_pay >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT payslip_deduction_nonneg CHECK (total_deductions >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT payslip_gross_ge_net CHECK (gross_pay >= net_pay),
    CONSTRAINT payslip_month_unique UNIQUE (employee_id, pay_month)
);

CREATE INDEX payslip_month_idx ON payslip (pay_month);

-- employee master table
CREATE TABLE employee (
    employee_id     BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_ref    VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    given_name      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    family_name     VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    hire_date       DATE        NOT NULL,
    line_manager_id BIGINT,
    status          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT employee_ref_unique UNIQUE (employee_ref),
    CONSTRAINT employee_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','ON_LEAVE','LEFT'))
);
-- leave request table
CREATE TABLE leave_request (
    request_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id  BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    from_date    DATE        NOT NULL,
    to_date      DATE        NOT NULL,
    days         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    status       VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT leave_employee_fk FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employee(employee_id),
    CONSTRAINT leave_dates_order CHECK (to_date >= from_date),
    CONSTRAINT leave_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED','CANCELLED'))
);

requirement: The monthly payroll batch shall produce a bank payment file with one line per paid employee, including their account number, sort code and net pay, and skip employees on unpaid leave.
